model.origin: karpathy/tinyllamas stories260K (MIT), Hugging Face revision 0bd21da7, fetched and sha256-checked by models/fetch_stories260k.sh

numerics: int8 weights per output column, int8 activations per call (per tensor), int32 bypass accumulators, host dequant + nonlinearities in f32, greedy decoding

split.fpga: linear layers on the FPGA: q, k, v, o, w1, w2, w3 in every layer and the classifier (int8 x int8 -> int32, M = 1)
split.laptop: on the laptop: token embedding, RMSNorm, RoPE, attention scores + softmax, SwiGLU, int8 quantize/dequantize, greedy sampling

wbuf_plan.rule: pin the matrix set that maximises resident bytes, leaving one scratch slot as large as the largest unpinned matrix; pinned matrices are written once and content-hash checked on every use

text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl

summary.wall_note: laptop wall time including UART at 1562500 baud; NOT accelerator speed (on-chip cycles come from the counters)
